name: Shogun's Seal (Imperial Hanko Detail)
description: Sovereign 3D showcase of the Shogunate's golden wax seal. A monumental square hanko seal stamp carved from solid gold and dark blood-red jasper stone, crowned with a sculpted dragon handle, resting next to vermilion cinnabar ink paste on black velvet.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of the sovereign Shogun imperial seal stamp. A massive square imperial hanko seal carved from solid heavy gold and dark red jasper stone, topped with a sculpted roaring dragon handle, resting beside a dark lacquer bowl of vibrant vermilion red cinnabar ink paste. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), dramatic crimson red (#FF2035) rim lighting and gold reflections, 8k render, no text.
